gloss: natural face; bare face without makeup

definitions.gloss: natural face; bare face without makeup
definitions.explanation: one's face without any makeup, cosmetic enhancements, or filters applied

examples.japanese: {地顔|じがお}がきれいな{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She has a naturally beautiful face.

examples.japanese: {化粧|けしょう}をしている{顔|かお}と{地顔|じがお}がだいぶ{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Her face with makeup and her natural face are quite different.

examples.japanese: SNSでは{加工|かこう}した{写真|しゃしん}ばかりで、{地顔|じがお}を{見|み}せる{人|ひと}が{少|すく}なくなった。
examples.english: On social media, there are mostly filtered photos, and fewer people show their natural face.

notes:
Combines {地|じ} (ground, base, natural state) and {顔|かお} (face). The prefix {地|じ} here means 'original' or 'unaltered,' the same {地|じ} found in {地毛|じげ} (natural hair) and {地声|じごえ} (natural voice). Commonly discussed in the context of beauty, cosmetics, and social media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地顔|じがお}がいい: to have a good natural face
- {地顔|じがお}を{見|み}せる: to show one's natural face
- {地顔|じがお}と{化粧|けしょう}{顔|がお}: natural face vs. made-up face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すっぴん: bare face, no-makeup face — the more common casual term
- {素顔|すがお}: bare face, true face — can also mean 'true self' figuratively
- {地毛|じげ}: natural hair — one's hair without dyeing or styling
